biotools.summary: Undertone is a web application developed by Helena Bioinformatics for interpreting whole-study GWAS summary statistics. It identifies and ranks associated loci and brings fine-mapping, candidate variants and genes, regulatory evidence, tissue or cell context, and mechanism hypotheses into traceable analysis workspaces and reports. Fine-mapping and downstream evidence depend on compatible inputs and reference data. Outputs support research and testable biological hypotheses; association evidence does not establish causality or clinical utility.
